verdict.rationale: Zero ships an official MCP server (ZeroMCP) documented in MCP.md with connection methods (Better Auth session token, with OAuth coming soon) and a rich set of exposed tools (email CRUD, search, labels, AI-assisted composition, thread Q&A, web search), directly matching the story of connecting an agent via an official MCP server. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration that external agents have successfully connected via ZeroMCP, and OAuth support is still 'coming soon' rather than complete.
